name: PR detail Files changed tab: Smart order groups, findings counter, Not in the diff, order switch
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm Smart Diff: the 'Core logic' group header shows '4 files' and the seeded open-findings counter '2 files with open findings' (both seeded files, src/config.ts and src/api/users.ts, have no patch); the 'Not in the diff' section lists the seeded finding 'Hardcoded Stripe secret key in commit'; clicking 'Original order' flips the URL to ?order=original and still renders src/config.ts as a flat list. Exercises the refactored diff-viewer (DiffViewer -> FileCard -> CodeLine) plus the new DiffTab grouping/order-switch wiring. Read-only seeded data (no model call, no Accept/Dismiss). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB (see e2e/README.md).
